qualification_gates.requirement: Six independent loops guarantee 6.000-6.400 A across component, supply, process and temperature tolerance
qualification_gates.evidence: MAX17527A and TPS1663 fail the window; LTC4281/4282 threshold spread exceeds the complete error budget before other terms; ADM1175 with exact WSK2512 exceeds 6.400 A; no calibration residual is authorized.

qualification_gates.requirement: Complete installed limiter path is <=57 mOhm hot
qualification_gates.evidence: No retained candidate has a complete hot shunt, pass FET, sense-copper, vias and connector path qualification. Typical/25 C screens do not close this gate.

qualification_gates.requirement: Source compatibility over 12.05-12.60 V sustained and 12.10-12.60 V peak
qualification_gates.scope: LTC4281/4282, ADM1175, MAX17527A and TPS1663 voltage classes
qualification_gates.evidence: Voltage classes are compatible where documented, but no exact installed limiter system is qualified for the signed source/transient contract.

qualification_gates.requirement: Calibration target, residual, fixture accuracy, temperature corners, retention and lot traceability are binding
qualification_gates.scope: LTC4281/4282 and ADM1175 candidate calibration paths
qualification_gates.evidence: Manufacturer trim/application text does not establish the PiSXMe production residual, fixture, retention or traceability contract; no such internal artifact exists in retained evidence.

qualification_gates.requirement: Gate drive and hot pass-FET RDS(on) are guaranteed at the actual minimum drive and temperature
qualification_gates.evidence: Existing FET screens are at 4.5 V/25 C or typical curves; exact controller minimum gate drive and hot installed RDS(on) remain unbound.

qualification_gates.requirement: Reverse current/polarity, surge, TVS, fuse, harness and nFET SOA/I2t are coordinated by worst-case waveform
qualification_gates.evidence: Only non-production illustrative screens exist; exact limiter timing, harness waveform, clamp, fuse and SOA/I2t coordination are absent.

qualification_gates.requirement: Installed package, copper spreading, thermal limits, DFM and procurement provenance are qualified
qualification_gates.evidence: No architecture has an approved exact coordinated MPN/package/footprint and installed thermal/test contract.

qualification_gates.requirement: Six-loop fail-safe FLAG/inhibit/reset behavior is explicit and verified
qualification_gates.evidence: No retained decision binds six independent fault paths, aggregation, brownout, inhibit or controlled restart behavior.

contract_checks.statement: MAX17527A retained 6 A screen must meet the independent 6.000 A floor
TPS1663 retained 6 A screen must remain within 6.000-6.400 A
LTC4281/4282 full-temperature threshold ratio must fit complete current-window ratio before all other error terms
ADM1175 with exact WSK2512R0160BEA screen must remain within 6.000-6.400 A without an unbound calibration contract
No retained candidate may be promoted when any mandatory system gate is FAIL or UNPROVEN

minimum_evidence_dependency.title: One exact qualified six-loop limiter-system record
minimum_evidence_dependency.minimum_record: A single authority-reviewed record for one exact retained architecture with exact controller/shunt/FET MPNs and packages, full-temperature/tolerance 6.000-6.400 A proof per loop, calibrated residual/fixture/retention/traceability contract, <=57 mOhm hot installed limiter path, gate-drive/hot RDS(on), reverse/fault/TVS/fuse/harness/SOA/I2t waveform, thermal/DFM/procurement proof, and six-loop fail-safe behavior.
minimum_evidence_dependency.why_minimum: Without this one system-level record, the signed HPQ4 current and hot-path invariants cannot be released to source or CAD work. No separate candidate family search is authorized by this package.
minimum_evidence_dependency.resume: Requalify exact nFET/protection assembly against the record, then release P24-POWER-SOURCE-CONTRACT and P24-EXACT-NFET-ENERGY-AUTHORITY through normal serialized authority and fresh-Light validation.

signature.decision: No retained candidate binds the complete HPQ4 six-loop limiter system. The product envelope and HPQ4 contract remain binding. The sole scoped resumption dependency is authority:6A-limiter-qualification.
signature.signature_basis: Current HEAD, signed HPQ4 JSON, retained Product/Power authority, ADM1175 component-path receipt, exact nFET receipt, and Librarian indexed manufacturer evidence. No measurements, vendor approval, fabricated-hardware proof, or CAD change is claimed.
